LESSON: CLEANING THE KITCHEN

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: AGRICULTURE AND NUTRITION
Strand: HYGIENE PRACTICES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested learnin
Topic 3.1: Cleaning the Kitchen
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 9

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Cleaning the Kitchen, part of HYGIENE PRACTICES Strand Sub strand Specific learning outcomes Suggested learnin in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 AGRICULTURE AND NUTRITION.

Key inquiry question: How can daily, weekly and special cleaning enhance hygiene in the kitchen?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Cleaning the Kitchen together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility: Engaging in assigned roles when cleaning the kitchen to maintain hygiene.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Health promotion as learners maintain hygiene by cleaning the kitchen.

Link to other subjects:

Learners relate cleaning the kitchen to prevent contamination of food to concepts of disease prevention learnt in Integrated

Science.
